name: Jac
caption: Trust your experience over your programming. 🐑

slides.text:
This might sound crazy,

but most of us were taught what life is supposed to feel like before we ever got to feel it for ourselves.

They told you
• work hard and you'll be happy
• buy the thing and you'll be enough
• stay in line and you'll be safe

Then you lived it.

And your experience told a different story.

If you ever feel like the life you were promised doesn't match the life you're living,

you're not broken.

You're just finally trusting what you EXPERIENCE over what you were TOLD.
